description_en: Checks the Cloud Data Transfer (CDT) service, which is required to add a region to an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 检查指定的地域加入专线网关所需的云数据传输服务
name: CheckAddRegionToExpressConnectRouter

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region that you want to add to ECR
parameters.help_zh: 指定专线网关功能是否开通云数据传输服务的地域
parameters.name: fresh_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run to check the request. No service resources are modified.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique token on your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

AnyCrossBorderLink.description_en:
Indicates whether the ECR instance has a cross-border connection between the Chinese mainland and a region outside the Chinese mainland. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
AnyCrossBorderLink.description_zh:
专线网关实例是否存在中国内地与中国境外跨境。取值：
true：是。
false：否

AnyInterRegionLink.description_en:
Indicates whether the ECR instance has an inter-region connection in the Chinese mainland. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
AnyInterRegionLink.description_zh:
专线网关实例是否存在中国内地跨地域。取值：
true：是。
false：否

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates that the call was successful. For information about other error codes, see the "Error codes" section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message. This message is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the error message.

If the ErrMessage parameter returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and this parameter returns DtsInstanceId, it means that the DtsInstanceId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsInstanceId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsInstanceId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

IsCdtCrossBorderEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the cross-border CDT service is enabled for the account to which the ECR instance belongs. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
IsCdtCrossBorderEnabled.description_zh:
专线网关实例所属账号是否开通跨境云数据传输（CDT）服务。取值：
true：是。
false：否

IsCdtInterRegionEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the CDT service is enabled for the account to which the ECR instance belongs. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
IsCdtInterRegionEnabled.description_zh:
专线网关实例所属账号是否开通云数据传输（CDT）服务。取值：
true：是。
false：否

IsUserAllowedToCreateCrossBorderLink.description_en:
Indicates whether the account to which the ECR instance belongs is allowed to create cross-border connections. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
IsUserAllowedToCreateCrossBorderLink.description_zh:
专线网关实例所属账号是否允许创建跨境。取值：
true：是。
false：否

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
